state: Two revised fashion-tactical16 sheets generated and visually reviewed; initial military-carrier direction rejected by user; new proposal awaiting approval
sharedSpecification:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce beautiful premium ANIME GAME COSTUME CONCEPT ART, with the user's existing SD heroine proportions. Exactly16 full-body figures,4x4 grid; rows C/B/A/S; columns MOBILITY/BALANCED/HEAVY/MAINTENANCE; codes C1 C2 C3 C4 / B1 B2 B3 B4 / A1 A2 A3 A4 / S1 S2 S3 S4. Same heroine in all16 cells. Original compact SD face/head/limbs, not adult long-legged fashion mannequin. Consistent scale and neutral gentle standing poses; all hair and feet inside cells.

ART DIRECTION CORRECTION: This game's identity is polished subculture heroine FASHION married to extraction equipment. The rejected kit was a monotonous stack of military plate carriers, box pouches and knee pads. Completely re-design the GARMENTS and their cuts. Like the design principles of stylish action-game techwear, use a deliberate flowing silhouette, asymmetric tailoring, contrasting fabric/technical panels, carefully designed open joints and elegant color blocking. Create ORIGINAL costumes; do not copy EVE or any specific Stellar Blade/NIKKE/NieR costume or character. Tactical hardware is a SMALL meaningful accent, not the whole outfit. Do not turn this into16 brown military vests,16 rectangular chest slabs,16 bulky backpacks, or16 plastic doll armor suits. No bright white sci-fi cuirass, huge hip fins, gold filigree or fantasy knight armor.

Clothing: opaque cropped tops/short jackets and secure opaque utility shorts or short split overskirts OVER shorts. Neutral nonsexual presentation. Restore intentional OPEN SHOULDERS/upper arms, a clearly visible moderate MIDRIFF gap, open upper-thigh/hip-joint space as outfit design choices. Use high necklines/opaque torso coverage, no cleavage, lingerie, sheer torso cloth, high-cut bodysuit, body emphasis or exaggerated anatomy. No blanket full-body military covering. Outfit style is cute, cool and fashionable, with readable compact SD forms and tailored details. Taper boots/gloves; avoid huge same-looking combat boots everywhere.

FOUR roles must have DIFFERENT WHOLE-OUTFIT silhouettes before considering color:
MOBILITY col1: sporty short OPEN HOODED SHRUG or asymmetric one-shoulder cropped jacket over a sleeveless high-neck athletic crop top; bare upper arms, fitted opaque shorts, one slender thigh strap, lightweight ankle boots, one small side pouch. Airy compact runner silhouette; no chest carrier.
BALANCED col2: smart short COLLARED FIELD JACKET with a clean diagonal closure over a fitted high-neck inner top, a modest waist gap, a short split fabric overskirt OVER opaque shorts, one suspended slim belt strap, tailored mid-calf boots. More structured short-jacket silhouette, restrained integrated protective insert rather than external box vest.
HEAVY col3: elegant broad-shouldered SHORT STRUCTURED BATTLE JACKET/vest with one broad continuous protective textile panel integrated under the garment, compact down-sloping shoulders, tapered waist, bare upper-arm/elbow joint, slim separated forearm and lateral thigh guards; opaque fitted shorts and tailored knee-high protection. A clean attractive protective silhouette with FEW layers, NOT an enormous metal chest plate or piled pauldrons/hip leaves. Its collar/upper-torso width and dedicated thin guards distinguish it from balanced, not number of pouches.
MAINTENANCE col4: stylish ASYMMETRIC CROPPED MECHANIC JACKET with one rolled sleeve and one open upper arm, a single diagonal waist strap, SHORT ONE-HIP FABRIC WORK APRON over fitted opaque shorts, compact tool roll and a single integrated service bag, asymmetric kneepad/boot details. Clearly mechanical/service FASHION silhouette, not heavy armor with extra bags. No medical cross.

Distinct TIER garment-construction identities must remain visible within EACH role:
C: repurposed casual STREETWEAR; simple stitched canvas/jersey, a softened hoodie collar or tied workshirt corner, one tasteful contrasting repair patch and reused buckle; soft imperfect hem but NO ragged medieval skirt. One small salvage insert at most. Faded but attractive, thoughtfully fitted to heroine.
B: refined ROUND-CUT BOMBER/PATROL tailoring; rounded short collar/cuffs, clean two-tone cloth panels, one rounded protective insert sewn INSIDE outfit, tidy short rounded hems and modest large side clasp. Distinct from C's soft tied/hooded surplus.
A: crisp ANGULAR TECHNICAL FIELDWEAR; sharp folded collar/lapel, straight diagonal zipper, controlled layered short jacket panel, precise seams, slim visible dark plate edging at shoulder/rib, two restrained quick-release fittings. Strong cut and disciplined asymmetric lines; not a boxy MOLLE carrier.
S: premium HIGH-FASHION TECHWEAR; precision asymmetric sculptural short jacket/bolero cut, curved-to-straight material transition, flush closure, slim integrated black composite edge, one clean fabric side tail or pleat adapted to role. Expensive refined fit and graphic silhouette, NOT shiny white armor. Less visual clutter, more original tailoring than A. Maintain open joints/midriff at high tier; higher grade does not mean covering more skin.

ROLE palette cues, integrated with character's personal signature:
Mobility graphite/slate with restrained cool mint/pale blue inner panel.
Balanced slate/ivory with a small rose/orange closure accent.
Heavy deep navy/charcoal with muted oxblood/plum structural cloth inset.
Maintenance charcoal/cool blue with warm amber/orange rolled lining and tool tab.
Tier progression changes panel cut, hem, closure and silhouette, not just recoloring. Keep color tasteful and varied; no uniform brown/olive wash. Pouches1-2 small functional pieces maximum except maintenance's compact tool kit. No weapons, helmets, shields, capes to floor, giant logos, text on clothes.

Rendering: match the supplied project's refined illustrated concept art: expressive crisp anime face, exquisite original hair, beautiful controlled fabric folds, thoughtful premium seams and material highlights; soft illustrated studio light, pale cool neutral background. Avoid toy-like shiny molded plastic and repetitive mannequin stance. Clean legible row/column typography. Footer "16 COSTUME CONCEPTS / FASHION + TACTICAL / NOT 3D FITTED".

serin.prompt:
Create SERIN's16 costume board titled "SERIN / FASHION TACTICAL ARMOR".
Reference1: NEW EDEL FASHION-TACTICAL16 board. This is the exact code-grid, garment CUTS, ROLE SILHOUETTES, tier progression and low-clutter costume reference. Transfer these same16 product designs to SERIN; do NOT return to military carriers or old white hard shells.
Reference2: actual PROJECT Serin/Edel concept sheet. SERIN is brown-haired heroine on LEFT. Use her own face, warm brown low side ponytail, rose-brown eyes, black/white layered street-tech fashion and restrained pink/orange color signature. Its fully clothed/tights look is historical context; apply the NEW open-shoulder/midriff/upper-thigh costume direction from reference1. For this armor-only sheet omit hat/helmet and weapon, keep brown ponytail visible.
Reference3: previous dressed SERIN16 sheet, identity and compact SD body/face/grid reference ONLY; all its old clothing/white shell equipment is excluded.
Exactly16 SERIN, no lavender braids, no EDEL faces. Keep her original compact SD torso and limbs, no adult long-legged mannequin reinterpretation. Original hair color throughout. Same role/tier garment construction as NEW EDEL board, fitted to SERIN contours. Proposed character colorway: translate EDEL slate-blue panels into SERIN charcoal/black, pale ice trim into restrained blush-pink accents, keep clean ivory/white contrast, small orange fasteners. Keep heavy's muted burgundy lining, maintenance's amber/orange utility accents, mobility's cool/pink small accent; no uniform gray/brown wash. These are colorway concept proposals, not gameplay changes.
